summary: Classification Self-Check redesign (Phase 2a) verified end-to-end on both web and mobile against the shared backend. Backend GET /api/public/csc/bands returns 200 with 8 bands, ascending annual_budget [10731,16034,21966,29696,39697,48114,58148,78106], budget_source_version=index-1. WEB (/ai-tools/classification-self-check) as cathy@example.com: csc-current prefilled to '4' from active participant Dorothy, csc-current-prefilled hint visible, all 16 csc-q-* rendered, csc-submit produces csc-result at width=1024px (max-w-5xl), csc-result-header is TEAL (rgb(14,77,82)) with WHITE text (rgb(255,255,255)) showing 'Classification 1', plain-language 'A little help / Mostly independent, with occasional help...' (NO 'Jean-style' jargon), two budget cards (per year / per quarter). csc-comparison renders with all 8 csc-comparison-row-1..8, csc-drivers card present. Regression: csc-assessor-toggle opens (12 domains listed), csc-download-pdf button present. MOBILE (/tool/classification-self-check) parity: prefill hint, 16 questions, teal header rgb(14,77,82) with white text, 8 comparison rows, drivers, no jargon; assessor + PDF regression OK. In dark mode the primary teal shifts to rgb(79,168,174) (lighter teal) — still colored with white text, remains legible; no dark-text-on-dark-bg detected.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' surfaced from emergent editor's dev-instrumentation wrapping the mapped <option> nodes in the csc-current <select>. Non-blocking (functional in browser) but noisy in console. Consider hoisting the option label to a plain string outside JSX expression or ignore if wrapper is dev-only.

action_items: (Optional) Silence the hydration warning coming from the emergent editor wrapper around <option> children in ClassificationCheck.jsx:597 — cosmetic only, does not affect UX.
critical_code_review_comments: Bands endpoint imports _budget_lookup / _quarterly_from_annual from lib.csc.scoring at call-time — safe, but move to module-level to avoid per-request import overhead.
Web comparison uses inline bar widths from Math.round(annual/max*100); rows have accessible testIDs 1..8 and highlighted primary — good.

Mobile ClassificationSelfCheck.tsx uses colors.primary for header bg which flips lighter in dark theme; text remains white, contrast OK. Consider locking header to a fixed dark teal in both themes for stronger brand recognition.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CSC redesign is functional on both surfaces. If UX iterates on dark-mode header color, revisit mobile header bg (currently colors.primary which lightens in dark theme to rgb(79,168,174)).
